article.title: Power to seize offensive weapons
article.content:
50Power to seize offensive weapons



Section 50 · Chapter V


The police officer or other person making any arrest under this Sanhita may, immediately after the
                arrest is made, take from the person arrested any offensive weapons which he has about his person, and
                shall deliver all weapons so taken to the Court or officer before which or whom the officer or person
                making the arrest is required by this Sanhita to produce the person arrested.
